notes:
Fixes grinder-initiated brewing that stopped with "weight not zero at start": after the TARE the screen now takes the scale's fresh post-TARE measurement as the current weight, and the start is held back (never started on cached data) until the weight it checks is as fresh as the verified zero. A refused or timed-out start no longer blocks the next knob press, and the Grind-by-Sync status shows exactly what the final check saw.
